title: Persona Trait Data Schemas
summary: This module defines Pydantic data models, primarily `PersonaTraitArtifact`, to structure and validate persona-related data like contrast prompts, evaluation questions, and judge rubrics for consistent use across persona development and experimentation.

nodes.label: Define Persona Trait Artifact Schema
nodes.title: Persona Trait Artifact Schema
nodes.description: Pydantic model defining the structure for a single persona trait bundle, including contrast prompts, evaluation questions, and judge rubrics. It ensures data consistency and validation for persona-related configurations.

nodes.label: Run Persona Experiments
nodes.title: Experiment Runners
nodes.description: Modules responsible for executing various persona-related experiments, such as coherence sweeps, validation, and steering evaluations. These components consume `PersonaTraitArtifact`s to define experimental conditions and parameters.

nodes.label: Generate Steering Demos
nodes.title: Steering Demonstrations
nodes.description: Components that generate and visualize steering demonstrations, potentially using `PersonaTraitArtifact`s to define the traits being demonstrated and the scenarios for observation.

nodes.label: Activate Persona Vectors
nodes.title: Persona Activations
nodes.description: Logic for activating and applying persona vectors within the system. This process relies on the structured data defined by `PersonaTraitArtifact`s to correctly interpret and apply persona characteristics.

groups.label: Data Definitions
groups.title: Data Definitions
groups.description: Contains Pydantic models and other structures that define the shape and validation rules for data used across the system, ensuring consistency and integrity.

groups.label: Persona Logic & Evaluation
groups.title: Persona Logic & Evaluation
groups.description: Modules that consume and process persona-related data structures for various tasks like experimentation, demonstration, and activation, driving core persona functionalities.
